Inspect, repair, and update Pomme-owned durable agent workflows.

```text
pomme agent SUBCOMMAND
```

## pomme agent status

Show durable agent workflow status.

```text
pomme agent status NAME [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | Pomme-owned VM name. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme agent repair

Repair a Pomme-owned agent workflow and restore its prior state.

```text
pomme agent repair NAME [--final-state FINAL_STATE] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | Pomme-owned VM name. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--final-state FINAL_STATE` | Final VM state: previous. Values: `previous`. Default: `previous`. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme agent update

Update the Pomme agent in a running VM to this host's Pomme build.

The VM must be running normal macOS with a connected agent. The agent is replaced in place and restarted; no Recovery boot or guest reboot is needed. It refuses while background jobs or terminal sessions are running, because the restarted agent could no longer manage them. Running it again when the agent already matches makes no change. `pomme agent repair` reinstalls the agent the VM was created with.

```text
pomme agent update NAME [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | Pomme-owned VM name. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).
